name: Takakura Chihiro
source:
She is cheerful, good-looking, excellent grades, an impeccable beautiful girl who can interact with anyone without discrimination. She is one of Shugo's few understanding people and seems to be very inspired. Although she is a little strong, she has a gentle and gentle personality. She is a little older than Shugo. Since the roots are serious, she also has the side of blushing and turning down when talking about naughty things. Because of the strength of his inspiration, she gets involved in various incidents. She is also best friends with Sayori.

[from Getchu]
